arxiv-2107-11983.title: ThunderRW: An In-Memory Graph Random Walk Engine
arxiv-2107-11983.creator: Shixuan Sun, Yuhang Chen, Shengliang Lu, Bingsheng He, Yuchen Li
arxiv-2107-11983.description: Abstract . As random walk is a powerful tool in many graph processing, mining and learning applications, this paper proposes an efficient in-memory random walk engine named ThunderRW . Compared with existing parallel systems on improving the performance of a single graph operation, ThunderRW supports massive parallel random walks.

arxiv-2109-09474.title: Energy Efficient Sampling Policies for Edge Computing Feedback Systems
arxiv-2109-09474.creator: Vishnu Narayanan Moothedath, Jaya Prakash Champati, and James Gross
arxiv-2109-09474.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vishnu Narayanan Moothedath, Jaya Prakash Champati, and James Gross. We study the problem of finding efficient sampling policies in an edge-based feedback system, where sensor samples are offloaded to a back-end server that processes them and generates feedback to a user. Sampling the system at maximum frequency results in the detection of events of interest with minimum delay but incurs higher energy costs due to the communication and processing of redundant samples.

arxiv-2110-08800.title: Equilibrium behavior in a nonequilibrium system: Ising-doped voter model on complete graph
arxiv-2110-08800.creator: Adam Lipowski, Dorota Lipowska
arxiv-2110-08800.description: Abstract While the Ising model belongs to the realm of equilibrium statistical mechanics, the voter model is an example of a nonequilibrium system. We examine an opinion formation model, which is a mixture of Ising and voter agents with concentrations p p and 1 − p 1-p , respectively.

arxiv-2311-07378.title: Unusual chemical bond and spectrum of beryllium dimer in ground X 1 ​ Σ g + X^{1}\Sigma_{g}^{+} state
arxiv-2311-07378.creator: A. V. Mitin, A. A. Gusev, G. Chuluunbaatar, O. Chuluunbaatar, S. I. Vinitsky, V. L. Derbov, Le Hai Luong
arxiv-2311-07378.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. V. Mitin, A. A. Gusev, G. Chuluunbaatar, O. Chuluunbaatar, S. I. Vinitsky, V. L. Derbov, Le Hai Luong. This review outlines the main results which lead to understanding the dual nature of the chemical bond in diatomic beryllium molecule in the ground X 1 ​ Σ g + X^{1}\Sigma_{g}^{+} state.

arxiv-2401-15904.title: Boundary touching probability and nested-path exponent for non-simple CLE
arxiv-2401-15904.creator: Morris Ang Xin Sun Pu Yu Zijie Zhuang
arxiv-2401-15904.description: Abstract The conformal loop ensemble (CLE) has two phases: for κ ∈ ( 8 / 3 , 4 ] \kappa\in(8/3,4] , the loops are simple and do not touch each other or the boundary; for κ ∈ ( 4 , 8 ) \kappa\in(4,8) , the loops are non-simple and may touch each other and the boundary.

arxiv-2402-00646.title: Cell-Free Massive MIMO SWIPT with Beyond Diagonal Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2402-00646.creator: Thien Duc Hua, Mohammadali Mohammadi, Hien Quoc Ngo, Michail Matthaiou
arxiv-2402-00646.description: Abstract This paper investigates the integration of beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs) into cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-mMIMO) systems, focusing on applications involving simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT). The system supports concurrently two user groups: information users (IUs) and energy users (EUs). A BD-RIS is employed to enhance the wireless power transfer (WPT) directed towards the EUs.

arxiv-2402-12511.title: Regular and Chaotic Motion of Two Bodies Swinging on a Rod
arxiv-2402-12511.creator: Lazare Osmanov, Ramaz Khomeriki
arxiv-2402-12511.description: Abstract We investigate regular and chaotic dynamics of Two Bodies Swinging on a Rod, which differs from all the other mechanical analogies: depending on initial conditions, its oscillation could end very quickly and the reason is not a drag force or energy loss. We use various tools to analyze motion, such as Poincaré section for quasi-periodic and chaotic cases.

arxiv-2408-01892.title: Re-ENACT: Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Speech Generation using Actor-Critic Strategy
arxiv-2408-01892.creator: Ravi Shankar 1 , Archana Venkataraman 1
arxiv-2408-01892.description: Abstract 1 Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore MD, USA † † address: † † email: rshanka3@jh.edu, archana.venkataraman@jh.edu In this paper, we propose the first method to modify the prosodic features of a given speech signal using actor-critic reinforcement learning strategy.

arxiv-2411-00750.title: Mitigating Tail Narrowing in LLM Self-Improvement via Socratic-Guided Sampling
arxiv-2411-00750.creator: Yiwen Ding, Zhiheng Xi, Wei He, Zhuoyuan Li, Yitao Zhai, Xiaowei Shi, Xunliang Cai, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
arxiv-2411-00750.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yiwen Ding, Zhiheng Xi, Wei He, Zhuoyuan Li, Yitao Zhai, Xiaowei Shi, Xunliang Cai, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang. Self-improvement methods enable large language models (LLMs) to generate solutions themselves and iteratively train on filtered, high-quality rationales. This process proves effective and reduces the reliance on human supervision in LLMs’ reasoning, but the performance soon plateaus. We delve into the process and find that models tend to over-sample on easy queries and under-sample on queries they have yet to master.

arxiv-2502-16781.title: MultiOCR-QA: Dataset for Evaluating Robustness of LLMs in Question Answering on Multilingual OCR Texts DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; July 13–18, 2025; Padova, IT ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Information s
arxiv-2502-16781.creator: Bhawna Piryani, Jamshid Mozafari, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Antoine Doucet, Adam Jatowt
arxiv-2502-16781.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bhawna Piryani, Jamshid Mozafari, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Antoine Doucet, Adam Jatowt. Optical Character Recognition (OCR) plays a crucial role in digitizing historical and multilingual documents, yet OCR errors -imperfect extraction of the text, including character insertion, deletion and permutation- can significantly impact downstream tasks like question-answering (QA). In this work, we introduce a multilingual QA dataset MultiOCR-QA , designed to analyze the effects of OCR noise on QA systems’ performance. The MultiOCR-QA dataset comprises 60K question-answer pairs covering three languages, English, French, and German.

arxiv-2509-21995.title: FailureAtlas : Mapping the Failure Landscape of T2I Models via Active Exploration
arxiv-2509-21995.creator: Muxi Chen, Zhaohua Zhang, Chenchen Zhao, Mingyang Chen, Wenyu Jiang, Tianwen Jiang, Jianhuan Zhuo, Yu Tang, Qiuyong Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Qiang Xu
arxiv-2509-21995.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Muxi Chen, Zhaohua Zhang, Chenchen Zhao, Mingyang Chen, Wenyu Jiang, Tianwen Jiang, Jianhuan Zhuo, Yu Tang, Qiuyong Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Qiang Xu. Static benchmarks have provided a valuable foundation for comparing Text-to-Image (T2I) models. However, their passive design offers limited diagnostic power, struggling to uncover the full landscape of systematic failures or isolate their root causes.

arxiv-2509-23427.title: StarveSpam : Mitigating Spam with Local Reputation in Permissionless Blockchains Thanks: This work was funded by NWO/TKI grant BLOCK.2019.004.
arxiv-2509-23427.creator: Rowdy Chotkan, Bulat Nasrulin, Jérémie Decouchant, Johan Pouwelse
arxiv-2509-23427.description: Abstract Spam poses a growing threat to blockchain networks. Adversaries can easily create multiple accounts to flood transaction pools, inflating fees and degrading service quality. Existing defenses against spam, such as fee markets and staking requirements, primarily rely on economic deterrence, which fails to distinguish between malicious and legitimate users and often exclude low-value but honest activity.

arxiv-2512-08316.title: PolySwyft : sequential simulation-based nested sampling
arxiv-2512-08316.creator: K. H. Scheutwinkel, 1,2, W. Handley, 1,2, C. Weniger 3, E. de Lera Acedo 1,2
arxiv-2512-08316.description: Abstract We present PolySwyft , a novel, non-amortised simulation-based inference framework that unites the strengths of nested sampling (NS) and neural ratio estimation (NRE) to tackle challenging posterior distributions when the likelihood is intractable but a forward simulator is available.

arxiv-2602-19934.title: Parallelism and Adaptivity in Student-Teacher Witnessing
arxiv-2602-19934.creator: Ondřej Ježil, Dimitrios Tsintsilidas
arxiv-2602-19934.description: Abstract Student-Teacher games are a model of computation where a computationally restricted student tries to find a string satisfying some refutable property, and every time the student outputs a candidate answer an all-knowing teacher tries to refute it if possible.

arxiv-2602-20901.title: SpatiaLQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Spatial Logical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2602-20901.creator: Yuechen Xie, Xiaoyan Zhang, Yicheng Shan, Zhu Hao, Rui Tang, Rong Wei, Mingli Song, Yuanyu Wan, Jie Song, [2mm] Zhejiang University, The University of Sydney, ManyCore
arxiv-2602-20901.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been increasingly applied in real-world scenarios due to their outstanding understanding and reasoning capabilities. Although VLMs have already demonstrated impressive capabilities in common visual question answering and logical reasoning, they still lack the ability to make reasonable decisions in complex real-world environments.

europmc-pmc4682161.creator: Jean Albrengues, Thomas Bertero, Eloise Grasset, Stephanie Bonan, Majdi Maiel, Isabelle Bourget, Claude Philippe, Cecilia Herraiz Serrano, Samia Benamar, Olivier Croce, Victoria Sanz-Moreno, Guerrino Meneguzzi

gao-gaoreports-gao-06-176.description: Veterans' Employment and Training Service: Labor Actions Needed to Improve Accountability and Help States Implement Reforms to Veterans' Employment Services (2005).

pmc-10588553.title: Order-Invariant Two-Photon Quantum Correlations in PT-Symmetric Interferometers
pmc-10588553.creator: Tom A. W. Wolterink, Matthias Heinrich, Stefan Scheel, Alexander Szameit
pmc-10588553.description: Multiphoton correlations in linear photonic quantum networks are governed by matrix permanents. Yet, surprisingly few systematic properties of these crucial algebraic objects are known. As such, predicting the overall multiphoton behavior of a network from its individual building blocks typically defies intuition.

pmc-11406153.title: Development, Implementation, and Assessment of an Online Modular Telehealth Curriculum for Health Professions Students [Letter]
pmc-11406153.creator: Mohammed Hasan Qureshi, Annabel Brewis, Sahana Gopalamurugan
pmc-11406153.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A), and Nurse Practitioner (NP) programs at Duke University demonstrated promising outcomes. Students reported increased confidence in telehealth skills and a moderate to high likelihood of applying these skills in future practice. Data collected through surveys indicated that the curriculum effectively improved students’ knowledge and confidence, although there was some variation in confidence levels between the different professional groups such as NPs who rated their conference slightly lower than the other groups.

pmc-11489682.title: The effect of platelet-rich fibrin on the biological properties of urothelial cells
pmc-11489682.creator: Shaohua Hu, Zhenli Zhao, Zhisheng Wan, Weizhen Bu, Songqiang Chen, Tianhong Han, Yiqun Lu
pmc-11489682.description: Urethral reconstruction presents a challenging issue in urology, primarily due to the limited availability of alternative materials for repair. The advancement of bioengineering technology has brought new hope to researchers, with a focus on the selection of appropriate biological scaffolds and seed cells.

pmc-11505371.title: Global Trends in Oliceridine (TRV130) Research from 2013 to 2024: A Bibliometrics and Knowledge Graph Analysis
pmc-11505371.creator: Cong Wang, Lidan Liu, Xue Bai
pmc-11505371.description: PurposeThe adverse effects and drug abuse issues associated with opioid drugs have made finding a safe and effective alternative a focus of research. Oliceridine has attracted attention for its lower adverse reactions, such as respiratory depression and gastrointestinal issues, compared to traditional opioids, and is considered a promising candidate for addressing the current limitations in opioid therapy.

pmc-11506820.title: Cost–Utility Analysis of PCSK9 Inhibitors and Quality of Life: A Two-Year Multicenter Non-Randomized Study
pmc-11506820.creator: José Seijas-Amigo, Maria José Mauriz-Montero, Pedro Suarez-Artime, Mónica Gayoso-Rey, Francisco Reyes-Santías, Ana Estany-Gestal, Antonia Casas-Martínez, Lara González-Freire, Ana Rodriguez-Vazquez, Natalia Pérez-Rodriguez, Laura Villaverde-Piñeiro, Concepción Castro-Rubinos, Esther Espino-Paisán, O
pmc-11506820.description: The primary objective of this study was to conduct a cost–utility analysis of proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors in real-world, comparing their use with standard care for managing cardiovascular disease. A multicenter prospective study was conducted across 12 Spanish hospitals from May 2020 to April 2022, involving 158 patients with hypercholesterolemia or atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

pmc-12020536.title: Safety and Precision AI for a Modern Digital Health System
pmc-12020536.creator: Elizabeth M. Borycki, Linda W. P. Peute, Femke van Sinderen, David Kaufman, Andre W. Kushniruk
pmc-12020536.description: SummaryArtificial intelligence (AI) promises to revolutionize healthcare. Currently there is a proliferation of new AI applications that are being developed and beginning to be deployed across many areas in healthcare to streamline and make healthcare processes more efficient. In addition, AI has the potential to support personalized and customized precision healthcare by providing intelligent interaction with end users.

pmc-13262050.title: Planning Strategies for Sustainable Electricity Systems Amidst Uncertainty: Case Study of the Yukon, Canada
pmc-13262050.creator: Chris Fitzgibbon, I. David Elder, Heather L. MacLean, I. Daniel Posen
pmc-13262050.description: Electric utilities face a growing challenge in maintaining low-cost and reliable electricity amidst emerging pressures for socio-environmental sustainability and reduction of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. In this work, we introduce an approach for generation expansion planning (GEP) that prioritizes sustainability objectives by implementing planning strategies that constrain future generation options based on socio-environmental indicators.

pmc-13405312.title: Public parks utilization and citizen satisfaction in Bangkok Metropolitan: An integrated theoretical model for tropical urban health
pmc-13405312.creator: Wichian Chanthanet, Weicong Li, Weicong Li, Weicong Li, Weicong Li

pmc-13676419.title: Diabetes‐Related Foot Disease as the Principal Reason for Hospital Admission: 5 Years of Data From a Major Tertiary Hospital in Aotearoa New Zealand
pmc-13676419.creator: Michele Garrett, Rinki Murphy, Arier Lee, Peter A. Lazzarini, Timothy Kenealy
pmc-13676419.description: ObjectiveTo examine hospitalisations caused by diabetes‐related foot disease (DFD) at the largest tertiary hospital in Aotearoa New Zealand.MethodsWe analysed hospital admission data for DFD‐caused hospitalisations from Auckland City Hospital (ACH), from 1 July 2014 to 30 June 2019, for people 15 years or older, using ICD10‐AM discharge codes and amputation procedure codes.
